Explicit Huber coordinates attain every term and every noise-sign realization. The risk is a strictly convex coercive perspective functional with interior optimum; its differentiated equations give the positive recurrence, unique scalar root, and sharp if-and-only-if adjacent-step threshold. Exact rational witness and 6248 finite checks supplement analytic steps. Caution: the published interpolation lemma is an external nonstandard input, inspected at its hypotheses and coefficient placement.

value.rationale: The theorem gives constructive exact minimax rates under realistically nonuniform oracle precision and a necessary/sufficient local learning-rate reversal boundary, not just a weighted risk inequality. Its inverse-variance high-noise limit shows arbitrarily many nonmonotone optimal updates and has direct consequences when precision improves later in a run. Limits on short steps, fixed variances and nonadaptive algorithms are explicit.
